man_clothes_size: The size of a jacket, pants, coat, jacket, sweater
neck_info: Using a tape measure, measure the bottom of your neck
chest_info: Using a measuring tape, measure the widest part of your chest
waist_info: Measure the narrowest part of your waist. Remember that the measuring tape should not be too taut.
hips_info: Measure the full part of your hips. To do this, hold the measuring tape horizontally.
height_info: Stand flat, barefoot on the measuring tape, press a linear object to the top of the head and record the measurement.
shoes_info1: Place a piece of paper on the floor and place your foot on it. Make marks near the heel and big toe. Measure the distance with a ruler and find the appropriate size: see size chart.
shoes_info2: Are your measurements in between two sizes? In this case, we suggest taking a larger size.
